notes.title: V3.9.3 Online Ranking Improvements
notes.content:
Online highscores, rankings and statistics increased and fixes:

V3.9.3

 When leaving online games early, the chip difference is transferred, but no score is awarded. Rank points are calculated based solely on the score, not on the chips.
 Bugfix: Not all hands and statistics were being saved.


V3.9.1

 Highscores show 100 entries now
 Online ranking and statistics up to 2000 entries
 Lags in transmitting rankings and statistics in the online game have been fixed. Server speed now massively increased.

notes.title: New Card Game Skat 3D Premium released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31252967/67aa9681339a810d57796fb30452381f9bacfb1c.jpg


Our new card game Skat is now available
Just like Trendpoker it can be played against AI opponents or Online

About the game
Skat is a trick-taking card game with 3 players very similar to Spades, and national game of Germany. All popular rule variants and very powerful but adjustable AI opponents are waiting for all who want to play this traditional card game. Game rules can be learned in the animated Tutorial.

Every single round, first the one who plays against 2 others has to be determined. This is done by the auction (German: "Reizen") meaning betting and competing, player with strongest bet may define the Trump suit - but plays against 2 other players!

notes.title: Update: New Environments, Cards, Music and Features
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31252967/06e371ab7d06796c2d025e44b1b6cdce3e8a159d.jpg

With 10 new environments, 5 new card backs and 5 new music tracks the update doubles them all.

New Features:

in multiplayer you can pre-select fold, fold-check or check-call
 you can choose your and other players' voices in sound settings menue
if folded, you can see your folded cards

notes.title: Major Update - Release approximately 22.2.2019
notes.content:
Next update will add new free features and content.

 Gameplay: see folded cards, select voices, pre-decision (fold,check..)
 New tables, environments and card decks

Thanks to the community for the great suggestions!

Now we finally start with the new stuff!

notes.title: Hotfix 2.03
notes.content:
A new version 2.03 is online (with bugfixes for online-mode):

    Fixed: when in 1-vs-1 online-mode the winning hand went all-in and the opponent at this moment disconnected on purpose - the hand that would have won, lost all chips
    Fixed: changing player's profile gender to female (voice) in online mode works now and is shown correctly
    Positions of [X]-buttons to remove other players before starting a game have been corrected

notes.title: Version 2.0 Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31252967/062fc5d35205ae8c866ac15821a854a8b0d93fcd.jpg

Dear friends of Poker,thank you for so many great ideas and positive feedback! Price is now permanently lowered to 14.99 USD. While working on a free demo and new features for a major update, at first we've fixed all known bugs and made various improvements primarily to ensure quality and compatibility.

Version 2.0 notes:
Screen resolution support for non-standard aspect ratios: up to 2.5 width-height ratio supported now (+fixes for problems with 5:4 and windowed mode resolutions)
Delete buttons for savegames added
Touchscreen control support:
game can be played with windows tablet pcs now
Heads-up-tournament steam achievements are working now
Singleplayer highscore bugfixes:
entries show correct players count and are not overwritten
Graphics & user interface changes:
layout, graphic improvements and fixes such as GUI elements background change from white to black, softshadow quality improved, layout corrections and other
Other fixes:
in some previous versions chatting didn't work, in specific cases, game crashed or didn't run without any error message
